terms.ru: Передача чужих слов и эвиденциальные формы

en.title: Reported and evidential forms
en.summary: Reported forms tell what is said or believed without naming the speaker.

paragraphs: Reporting forms tell what someone said, thinks or believes. Evidential forms show how the speaker knows something: by seeing, by hearing, or by report. English uses reporting verbs, passive constructions and verbs such as seem and appear.

items: It **is said** that the house is haunted.

blocks.html:
VerbPatternExample
saysay that + clauseShe said that she was ill.
telltell + person + thatShe told me that she was ill.
askask + whether / ifHe asked if I was ready.
suggest, advise+ -ing / thatShe suggested going home.
promise, refuse+ to-infinitiveHe promised to call.

paragraphs: To report general belief without naming who believes it, English uses a passive with a reporting verb: It is said that..., It is believed that..., He is said to be... The to-infinitive form is common in news reports.

blocks.html:
PatternExample
It is said / believed / reported that + clauseIt is reported that three people were hurt.
subject + is said to + infinitiveThe house is said to be haunted.
subject + is thought to have + participleHe is thought to have left.

paragraphs: Seem and appear show a judgement based on evidence. They are followed by an adjective, to + infinitive, or that + clause: She seems tired; He seems to know; It seems that nobody came.

blocks.html:
FormExample
seems / appears + adjectiveHe seems upset.
seems to + verbShe seems to like it.
It seems that + clauseIt seems that nobody knew.
apparently, reportedlyApparently, the train is late.

items: Wrong: **He said me that he was ill.** Right: **He told me** / **He said that**
Wrong: **She asked if was I ready.** Right: **She asked if I was ready.** (statement word order)
Wrong: **It is said to be raining.** Right: **It is said that it is raining.**

ro.title: Forme relatate și evidențiale
ro.summary: Folosim verbe reflexive și impersonale pentru a relata informații fără a numi vorbitorul.

paragraphs: Formele relatate transmit ce spun alți oameni. Formele evidențiale arată o impresie sau o informație nesigură. În limba română folosim structuri impersonale cu «se» și verbul «a părea».
Adăugăm pronumele «se» în fața unui verb la persoana a treia singular. După aceste verbe folosim «că» sau modul conjunctiv cu «să». Verbul «a părea» se combină des cu «să» și un alt verb.

blocks.html:
FormăRolExemplu
Se spune căTransmite o vorbă auzită**Se spune că** el este medic.
Se pare căExprimă o bănuială**Se pare că** vine furtuna.
Pare săDescrie aparența cuivaEa **pare să fie** obosită.
Se crede căArată o părere generală**Se crede că** locul aduce noroc.
